dataset_name: Signature and Cheque Verification Benchmark Dataset

genuine_pairs.description: Intra-writer genuine variants (same author, different signing turns). Contains CEDAR benchmark writers and synthetic reference variants.

skilled_forgeries.description: Attempted forgeries of same name/style. Contains CEDAR skilled forgeries and envelope-mimic synthetic forgeries.

random_forgeries.description: Different people entirely (cross-writer pairs). Contains CEDAR cross-author signatures and different synthetic authors.

cheques.description: Full cheques with background pantograph, security microprinting, payee line, date box, courtesy amount, MICR line, and signature box.
